error.edit.media_exists: Media {media_id} is already in the project.
error.edit.track_no_fields: The track has no such fields: {fields}.
error.edit.bad_track_kind: Unknown track kind: {kind}. Expected speech, speech-mix, or music.
error.edit.bus_no_fields: The bus has no such fields: {fields}.
error.edit.clip_outside_media: The clip reaches outside its media.
error.edit.trim_empty: The trim would leave an empty clip.
error.edit.split_outside: The split point is not inside the clip.
error.edit.clip_no_fields: The clip has no such fields: {fields}.
error.transcribe.missing_extra: Local transcription needs faster-whisper: run uv sync --extra transcribe.
error.transcribe.changed: The transcript changed while transcription was running. Run it again to replace the newer transcript.
error.jobs.closed: The background job runner is closed.
error.transcribe.colab_unavailable: Colab transcription is not available yet.
error.media.offline: The source file {name} is offline. Relink it before transcription.
error.import.nhsx_failed: Could not import Hindenburg session {path}. Check that it is a valid .nhsx file.
error.import.nhsx_missing_media: The session refers to audio file {name}, which could not be found.
error.clock.rate: {rate} Hz is not supported: positions on the recording clock would not be exact. Convert the file to a standard rate such as 48000 Hz first.
error.media.read_only: This project is open read-only, so media cannot be added or changed.
error.media.id_collision: {name} cannot be imported: a different file already has the media id {media_id}. This is extremely unlikely; please report it.
error.media.empty: {name} is empty (0 bytes or no audio frames), so there is nothing to import.
error.media.probe_timeout: {name}: checking the file took more than {seconds} s, so it was skipped. Is the drive or network share still connected?
error.media.decode_timeout: {name}: the decoder stopped responding for {seconds} s and was stopped. Nothing was imported from this file.
error.media.disk_full: {name} needs about {needed_mb} MB but only {free_mb} MB is free on the project's disk. Free up space and import it again; nothing was left behind.
error.media.source_vanished: {name} disappeared while it was being imported: is {drive} still connected? The half-imported file was removed; import it again when the drive is back.
error.media.all_failed: None of the {count} files could be imported. {details}
warn.media.partial: {name} is damaged or cut short: only {got} of {of} could be read. That part was imported.
warn.media.partial_unknown: {name} is damaged or cut short: only the first {got} could be read. That part was imported.
warn.media.downmixed: {name} has {channels} channels; it was mixed down to stereo.
warn.media.bad_time_reference: {name} has a recorder start time {hours} hours into the day, which cannot be right; the time was ignored and the file will not line up with others by its clock.
error.media.no_original: Could not find the original file for {name}.
error.media.hash_mismatch: The file at {path} does not match {name} (expected {expected}, got {actual}).
error.history.no_edit: There is no edit {edit} in this project.
error.history.no_step: There is no step {node} in this edit.
error.history.read_only: This project is open on {host}, so it is read-only here.
error.history.rate_change: The edit is at {rate} Hz but the project is at {project_rate} Hz; changing the project rate is not supported yet.
error.history.media_not_imported: Media {media_id} has not been imported into this project.
error.history.material_changed: “{label}” cannot be undone here: the same material has been changed again since. Use the history panel to choose what to keep.
error.package.too_new: This project was made by a newer kuulas ({written_by}); update kuulas to open it.
error.package.needs_migration: This project is in an older format and must be opened as a project folder to be upgraded.
error.package.upgrade_locked: This project is in an older format and is open on {host}; it can be upgraded once it is closed there.
error.session.bad_word_index: There is no word {index} on the timeline; it has {count} words.
error.people.no_person: There is no person {person_id} in this project.
error.people.no_interview: There is no interview {interview_id} in this project.
error.people.no_transcript: {media_id} has no transcript, so its speakers cannot be mapped yet.
error.people.bad_field: A person or interview has no field called {field}.
error.series.bad_id: {item_id} is not a valid id for a series item.
series.conflict: A sync conflict in {kind}: {name} is a second copy of {item_id}. Compare the two and delete the one you do not want.
series.unreadable: {name} in {kind} cannot be read, so {item_id} is left out. Restore it from the sync service's history.
series.mismatched: {name} in {kind} holds a different item than its name says, so it is left out.
log.series.project_skipped: Skipped {path}: it could not be read.
log.analysis.overlap: Clips overlap on track {track_id}, so its levels are measured from the audio.
error.cache.no_key: A cache key for {algorithm} could not be computed, so the cache is not used.
error.peaks.no_level: There are no peaks at {level} frames per peak; use one of {levels}.
error.peaks.no_tile: Peaks at {level} frames per peak have no tile {tile}.
log.cache.no_key: No cache key for the {kind} of {media_id}; computing it without the cache.
log.cache.spill_failed: Could not write {path}; that cache entry stays in memory only until it is pushed out.
log.cache.stats: Cache {kind}: {rate}% hits ({hits} in memory, {disk_hits} from disk, {misses} computed); memory {used_mb} of {limit_mb} MB.
log.migrate.sync_disagrees: Pieces of {media_id} disagreed about their place in sync group {group}; kept the one of clip {clip_id}, which plays against the main recording.
log.package.read_only: Opened read-only: the project is open on {host}.
log.package.stale_lock: Taking over a stale lock left by {host} (last heartbeat {heartbeat}).
log.package.migrating: Upgrading the project format from {source} to {target}; a backup is made first.
log.package.tick_failed: Lock heartbeat or backup failed, retrying later: {error}
log.session.subscriber_failed: A listener for project changes failed; the change itself was saved.

log.session.consolidated.one: Copied {count} linked file into the project.
log.session.consolidated.other: Copied {count} linked files into the project.

error.engine.no_device: No audio output device was found. Connect headphones or speakers, or choose an output in the system's sound settings; the project stays open.
error.engine.open_failed: The audio output {device} could not be opened: {error}

notice.engine.block_failed.one: {count} block of audio could not be played and was replaced with silence. Playback continues.
notice.engine.block_failed.other: {count} blocks of audio could not be played and were replaced with silence. Playback continues.

notice.engine.struggling: Playback is struggling to keep up, so the audio buffer is now {frames} frames. Close other programs or let background work finish.
notice.engine.device_changed: The audio output changed, so playback paused. Press play to continue on {device}.
notice.engine.restarted: The audio output stopped responding and was restarted on {device}.
notice.engine.resampling: {device} cannot play at {rate} Hz, so playback is converted to {device_rate} Hz. Exports are not affected.
notice.engine.media_damaged: Part of {name} could not be read (around {time}) and plays as silence. It can be rebuilt from the original file.
log.engine.block_failed: An audio block failed and played as silence: {error}
log.engine.tick_failed: The playback helper hit an error and carries on.
log.engine.refresh_failed: Reading the list of audio devices again failed: {error}
